articles.title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai
articles.summary: On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a kick-off event for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards, themed “Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins.” Wynn announced the 2027 calendar, with judging week in Beijing from August 21–25 and the annual awards ceremony in Macao on October 29.

articles.title: GEG Donates MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong to Support Its Annual Fundraising Campaign for the 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign, marking its 23rd consecutive year of support. Since 2004, GEG has donated more than MOP11 million to the charity.

articles.title: Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.summary: Sands China donated funds and gifts valued at over MOP 400,000 to Caritas Macau for the 2026 Charity Run and the 57th Caritas Macau Charity Bazaar, marking 23 consecutive years of support. 150 Sands Cares Ambassadors also volunteered at both events.

articles.title: Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.summary: Sands China’s Performing Arts Programme presented the Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert, uniting more than 550 musicians from Macao and France. The programme also staged a school outreach concert featuring France’s Amet’s Family.

articles.title: MGM Supports Tung Sin Tong’s Annual Charity Event for the 19th Consecutive Year
articles.summary: MGM donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign, marking its 19th consecutive year of support and bringing cumulative donations to MOP10 million.

articles.title: Mr. Francis Lui Named Asia’s Most Influential Industry Leader for the 10th Time; Advancing Innovation and Industry Development
articles.summary: Mr. Francis Lui, Chairman of Galaxy Entertainment Group, has been named the most influential industry leader in the “2026 Asian Gaming Power 50” for the 10th time. GEG’s Chief Operating Officer – Macau, Kevin Kelley, was also named to the list this year.

articles.title: Chef Tam's Seasons at Wynn Palace Once Again Ranks Among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026 51-100 List
articles.summary: Chef Tam's Seasons, the signature Cantonese restaurant at Wynn Palace, once again ranks among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026, taking the No.73 spot on the 51-100 list and remaining the only restaurant in Macao on the ranking. It also ranked No.7 in The 50 Best Restaurants Asia 2026, announced in March — the third consecutive year it has been the only Macao restaurant on that list.

articles.title: GEG Recognized as Top Winner at HR Excellence Awards 2026; Honored with the Grand Winner Award for its Excellence in Talent Development
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group received eight accolades at the HR Excellence Awards 2026, including the Grand Winner Award, and was the only integrated tourism and leisure enterprise in Macau among this year’s recipients. The honours include five Gold awards for employee development, leadership development, internship recruitment, volunteerism, and ESG strategy.
